name: Monte Carlo Path Tracing for Volume Rendering
aliases: Monte Carlo Volumetric Path Tracing (MC VPT)
definition: A volume rendering technique using Monte Carlo path tracing for scattering, with distance sampling and transmittance calculation, accumulating results over frames.
summary: Monte Carlo Path Tracing for Volume Rendering is a unified, progressive stochastic framework that produces photo-realistic volumetric images using Woodcock tracking and stochastic sampling instead of traditional ray marching.
